title: Users
description: Manage your team, their roles and the audit trail.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this page
forbidden.description: User management requires administrator rights. Contact your company administrator if you need access.

empty.title: No members yet
empty.description: Invite your teammates to start managing panels together.

roleDescriptions.owner: Full control of the company: all settings, members and data.
roleDescriptions.admin: Manages members, settings and approvals; cannot act on owners.
roleDescriptions.engineer: Prepares panels, revisions, schematics and labels; can approve revisions.
roleDescriptions.technician: Scans QR codes in the field, views approved schematics, logs issues and maintenance.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Read-only access to panels and approved schematics.

locations.title: Location access
locations.explain: If none are selected the user can access all locations. Restrictions apply to engineers, technicians and viewers; admins and owners always see every location.
locations.adminNote: This user is an admin or owner, so restrictions do not apply.
locations.noneDefined: No locations are defined yet. Add some under Settings > Locations first.
locations.allSelected: None selected: access to all locations.
locations.selected: {count, plural, one {# location selected} other {# locations selected}}

blocked.ownerProtected: Admins cannot make changes to owners.
blocked.self: You cannot change your own role, status or membership.
blocked.lastOwner: The last active owner cannot be demoted, suspended or removed. Assign another owner first.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.description: The user can no longer sign in or access data. You can reactivate them at any time.

activate.title: Reactivate {name}?
activate.description: The user can sign in again with their previous role and location restrictions.

remove.title: Remove {name} from the company?
remove.description: The user loses access to this company. Their name stays in past records.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.description: An invitation link is sent to their email address.
invite.sent: Invitation email sent to {email}. The link is valid for 14 days.

roles.intro: See what each role can do below. Roles are fixed; assign the one that fits each user.
roles.members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
roles.approveNote: Company policy can restrict this further (Settings > Policies).

manage_org.label: Company settings
manage_org.description: Edits company details, policies and locations.

manage_users.label: User management
manage_users.description: Invites users and changes roles and access.

view_audit.label: Audit log
view_audit.description: Views the full activity history and verifies its integrity.

crud_panels.label: Panel management
crud_panels.description: Creates, edits and archives projects, system groups, panels and cabinets.

create_revision.label: Prepare revisions
create_revision.description: Opens revisions and edits schematics and the BOM.

report_issue.label: Report issues
report_issue.description: Reports issues and attaches photos from the field.

export_data.label: Export data
export_data.description: Downloads panel, issue and maintenance data as Excel/CSV.

scan_qr.label: Scan QR codes
scan_qr.description: Scans panel QR codes to open their identity.

empty.title: No entries yet
empty.description: Activity in your company will appear here.

audit.noDetails: No additional details for this entry.

verify.intact: The audit chain is intact: no entry has been altered or removed.
verify.broken: The audit chain is broken: tampering or deletion was detected. Report it to your system administrator.
verify.failed: Verification could not be completed. Try again.
